articles.title: Tariff Tango: U.S. Slaps 25% Levy on Brazil, But the Trade Math Doesn't Add Up
articles.summary: The Trump administration announced a 25% tariff on Brazilian imports, citing deforestation and digital trade barriers. But U.S. data shows a trade surplus with Brazil, raising questions. A public comment period opens Thursday, ending July 1, with a hearing July 6.

articles.title: California's High-Stakes Primary: A Redistricting Reckoning
articles.summary: California Democrats redrew congressional maps to counter GOP gains in Texas, targeting up to five seats. But Tuesday's primary tests that strategy, especially in a San Diego district where nine Democrats risk splitting the vote and being shut out of the general election.

articles.title: Court Halts $1.8 Billion 'Anti-Weaponization' Fund as Primaries Heat Up
articles.summary: A federal court ordered a pause on the Trump administration's $1.8 billion fund for alleged victims of government overreach, amid bipartisan fears it could compensate January 6 rioters. Six states hold primaries today, with competitive governor races in California and Iowa.
